name: Companion command model: follow, wait, go to a point, interact
body: A Companion that walks with her own character controller and obeys commands (call, wait, send to a point, then interact), with simple keys. The scripted route stays for the existing levels.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's feedback that the Crimson and Thorn loop needs prototyping: more companion mechanics, more variety, a fuller level slice.

acceptance_criteria: Keys call, wait and send her
She follows, waits, walks to a command point and acts there
